subtasks: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
Pick up the pliers to the right of the toolbox and place them flat in their matching recess.
Reorient the pliers lying diagonally at the right edge of the toolbox. Seat them in the right-hand recess with their jaws toward the back and both handles toward the front.
Place the adjustable wrench in the narrow middle recess of the toolbox with its head toward the back.
Place the yellow tape measure flat into the rectangular back-right pocket of the toolbox.
Pick up the diagonal pliers at the front-right rim. Turn them and place them in the right-hand recess, jaws toward the rear and handles toward the front. Return both arms home with open grippers.
